newsitem.title: USA: Insilco Corp up after announcements.
newsitem.headline: Insilco Corp up after announcements.

text.p: Insilco Corp rose four to 42 bid on volume of 500 shares on Nasdaq Thursday after it announced late Wednesday it will sell its Rolodex unit.
It also said late Wednesday it earned $1.27 a share in the fourth quarter versus year-ago $0.07 (including an $0.80 reorganization goodwill amortization charge).

"I think the market is encouraged by the Rolodex sale -- by the price that we got for it and by the fact that we completed it and that we're now becoming a more focused company," treasurer David Kauer said in a telephone interview.
Columbus, Ohio-based Insilco said it will sell the unit to Newell Co for about $117 million less transaction costs and subject to regulatory approval.
Kauer said Insilco wanted to release both statements simultaneously so waited until the Newell agreement was signed, late in the day, to issue them.
Insilco makes automotive radiator and air conditioner components and telecommunications and electronic components and publishes school yearbooks.
Illinois-based Newell, which was up 5/8 to 35-3/4 on the New York Exchange, makes consumer housewares, office products, hardware and tools and home furnishings.
